projectDescription: A personal developer portfolio built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS, showcasing skills, projects, experience, education, achievements, and a contact form.
keyFeatures: Single-page portfolio with animated sections using Framer Motion
Auto day/night dark mode based on OS preference
Web Worker-based data loading to keep main thread responsive
Contact form with rate limiting (3 emails/hour per IP) via Netlify Functions
Reusable component architecture with DRY principles
TypeScript throughout with strict type definitions
TailwindCSS v4 styling with custom CSS variables for theming
Deployed on Netlify with custom domain and SSL/TLS
publicApiSurface: Card({ title, subtitle, duration, detail, className, link, linkIcon }: CommonItem)
ProjectCard({ title, image, detail, points, link, techStack, linkIcon }: ProjectItem)
ContactCard({ title, link, image, content }: ContactItem)
LoadData web worker — postMessage({ type: SectionType }) => { type, data }
Netlify Function: POST /.netlify/functions/sendMail — { firstname, lastname, email, subject, message }
